apps.name: RagaMentor
apps.versionDescription: v1.5.32 — Loop state restore: leave a song while a loop or group is playing and come back, and the page now returns fitted to the armed loop with its highlight and hold, instead of resetting to the full-song view. The Loops tab also reopens inside the armed group. Opening a song with a remembered loop fits the waveform to it too.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.
